sloka: पतितं तमभिज्ञाय राक्षसी सा महाचमूः।वध्यमाना दिशो भेजे हरिभिर्जितकाशिभिः ।। ६.९१.७९ ।।
transliteration: patitaṁ tamabhijñāya rākṣasī sā mahācamūḥ।vadhyamānā diśo bheje haribhirjitakāśibhiḥ ।। 6.91.79 ।।

translations.english: Great army of Rakshasas even though desired to win seeing (Indrajith dead), Vanaras started attacking them. Unable to bear Rakshasas screamed.
